peak-sprays.changelog:
- Layered Graffiti Studio: Multi-text layers with independent typography, move/scale/rotate, outlines, drip runs, splatter spray, neon glow, and distress weathering.
- My Designs Library: Drafts, Saved Designs, Recent History, Server Templates, and Gang/Crew shared tags.
- Advanced Image Importer: Clipboard paste (Ctrl+V), drag & drop, URL import, brightness/contrast/monochrome/blur filters, and automatic background removal.
- Textured Brush Presets: Sidewalk chalk, street crayon, marker bleed, stipple dots, rough spray, paint roller, and scratched paint combined with Peak physics.
- Non-Destructive Layers: Reorder, hide, lock, duplicate, and delete freehand, text, image, and stencil layers.
- Gang & Crew Templates: Official gang tag publishing with auto-generated variants (small, mural, territory mark, monochrome).
- 100% WYSIWYG Wall Preview: Real wall textures (brick, concrete, metal, wood, tile), 3D perspective tilt, and street lighting simulator matching world DUI.
- Smart Placement Tools: Surface normal snapping, alignment guides, rotation snapping (45°), sizing presets (small to mural), fit-to-wall auto boundary detection, and duplicate placement mode.
- JSON Design Import/Export: Portable composition sharing format for community templates.
- Polished Creation UX: Unified flow from type selection, design, preview, draft saving, placement, painting, to publishing.
